response.overview: Eight friends visit an uninhabited island, where they meet Hamid Ali, a hermit living in a hut. Tensions rise when Azmee teases his crush, Husna, who is dating Dhaain. Trapped by low tide, they stay overnight, sharing horror stories around a barbecue. Hamid reveals a tragic past: his son Eevan, possessed by a spirit, killed his girlfriend Taniya. To escape society, Hamid brought Eevan to the island, where the boy eventually died. Panic sets in when Unaish vanishes while fetching a torch, leaving only his light behind. The group finds Unaish’s corpse, then discovers Reena and Hamid beaten to death. Suspecting Azmee, they tie him to a tree, but Yooshau dies shortly after. One by one, the friends are murdered until only Azmee and Taniya remain. A rescue boat spots them, but Azmee rushes back into the island to distract the spirit.
response.title: Edhathuru
